gaps.lead: Nobody can deny that she is talented.
gaps.explanation: 'Nobody can deny that' → 'it cannot be denied that'.

gaps.lead: She found it hard to understand the accent.
gaps.explanation: 'Have difficulty (in) doing' = find it hard to do.

gaps.lead: It isn't necessary to book in advance.
gaps.explanation: 'Don't have to' = it is not necessary.

gaps.lead: Although she was exhausted, she carried on working.
gaps.explanation: despite/in spite of + -ing: despite being exhausted.

gaps.lead: I regret not bringing an umbrella.
gaps.explanation: Regret about the past: wish + subject + had + participle.

gaps.lead: No changes will be made to this project.
gaps.hint: go ahead = proceed; according to plan
gaps.explanation: 'No changes' means the project 'will go ahead according to plan'.
